cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Junior Performance Marketer - Mainstream position at David Kennedy Recruitment's client, the fast-growing consumer AI company. The role's emphasis on launching, testing and optimising paid campaigns across mainstream channels is exactly the kind of hands-on work I want to do more of.

My background combines digital marketing with a technical edge. In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I use Google Ads and Google Analytics to monitor performance and inform decisions. I've built and optimised websites from the ground up—handling everything from keyword research to structured data—and I approach each project with a testing mindset: try an audience, a creative or a page change, measure the result, and keep what works. That habit of iterating based on CAC, ROAS and conversion data is central to how I operate.

I'm fluent in English and comfortable explaining my personal contributions and results. I also use AI tools daily for research, content and audits, which helps me move quickly from analysis to concrete action. While my experience with large consumer acquisition budgets is still developing, I'm eager to take ownership of individual campaigns and grow towards managing larger budgets independently.

The opportunity to work directly within a growth function at a consumer AI company is compelling. I'm based in Belgium (CET) and open to a B2B contractor engagement. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my skills fit your team's needs.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
